indicator_name: Weekly prices of socially significant food products (2026 basket, 31 items), KZT
description: Еженедельные цены на социально значимые продовольственные товары (корзина 2026 г., 31 товар), тенге
unit: KZT per kg (per litre: milk, kefir, sunflower oil; per ten: eggs)
methodology: Taldau 703112 «Цены на продовольственные товары», weekly period (period_id 2), national average; each ISO week is dated its Wednesday, the registration day (week 44 of 2026 = the BNS bulletin «на 28 октября 2026»). From 2026 week 2; Taldau trails the weekly bulletin by about a week. Bread 222.75 (2026-w02) to 231.91 (w44), beef with bones 3 608 to 3 811, sugar 413 to 405, potatoes 195 to 211. The only weekly inflation signal: the 2022-2025 basket is SOCIAL_FOOD_PRICES_WEEKLY_2022_2025, with other product specifications -- do not join the two.
